description: This file contains test cases for the HostEnvSanitizer component, verifying environment variable sanitization, override handling, and diagnostics within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: HostEnvSanitizerTests
classes.description: A collection of test methods for validating the environment variable sanitization logic.

methods.name: sanitize blocks shell trace variables
methods.description: Tests that certain environment variables related to shell tracing are cleared during sanitization.

methods.name: sanitize shell wrapper allows only explicit override keys
methods.description: Verifies that only specified environment variables are preserved when using a shell wrapper.

methods.name: sanitize non shell wrapper keeps regular overrides
methods.description: Checks that environment overrides remain unchanged when not using a shell wrapper.

methods.name: inspect overrides rejects blocked and invalid keys
methods.description: Ensures that certain blocked or invalid environment variable keys are correctly identified during inspection.

methods.name: sanitize accepts Windows-style override key names
methods.description: Confirms that environment variable keys with Windows-style naming are accepted and preserved.
